title: Extract duplicated E2E fixture helpers (_EmptyContentRepository, _navigateTo, silence overrides) into a shared file instead of copy-pasting across 5 journey files
rule: Fowler duplication lens (no numbered standards-doc rule; general quality)
why: diff confirms progress_p0_test.dart:64-107 and progress_p1_test.dart:55-98 hold a byte-identical 44-line _EmptyContentRepository stub; _navigateTo and six silence-override one-liners (_sacredWindowNullOverride, _connectivitySilenceOverride, _incomingGrantsEmptyOverride, _pendingInvitesEmptyOverride, _pendingRedemptionsZeroOverride, _pointsBalanceZeroOverride, _dashboardSilence) are duplicated 2-3x across profiles_p0/p1/tutoring_p2_test.dart. When a provider's override shape changes, every copy needs an independent, easy-to-miss update — several in-file comments (e.g. profiles_p0_test.dart:110-128) already document discovering the SAME Drift-timer-leak workaround independently per file, which is the exact 'dumping ground / re-implementation elsewhere' cost AG-3's own rationale warns oversized, uncentralized files produce.
recommendation: Move these into E2EHarness itself (alongside the existing dashboardSilenceOverrides getter) or a new test/e2e/helpers/e2e_overrides.dart, and have all 5 files import the shared version — Fowler's 'Extract Class' / 'Pull Up Method'.
acceptance_criteria: One canonical implementation of _EmptyContentRepository, _navigateTo, and the silence-override helpers exists under test/e2e/harness/ or test/e2e/helpers/.
The 5 files import it instead of redefining it; dart analyze is clean and all existing tests in the 5 files still pass unmodified.
